56th ANNIVERSARY EARTH DAY 2026; MAIN EVENT IN LATIN AMERICA









Following COP30, amid rapid geopolitical, economic, and governance shifts, Earth Day 2026 in Brazil, South America, and across Latin America will mark a moment of renewed purpose and collective leadership. Led by EARTHDAY.ORG, Earth Day 2026 will focus on translating multilateral climate commitments and funding into visible, society-driven action. It will mobilize cities, schools, Indigenous and traditional communities, youth, faith groups, civil society, and the private sector to demonstrate that the Global South is actively shaping solutions through climate education, green jobs, and inclusive participation. In doing so, Earth Day 2026 will reaffirm climate action as a shared responsibility and a unifying force for sustainable development.

In December 2025, the Regional Directorate advanced entity EARTHDAY.ORG’s transition in Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC) from policy advocacy to implementation, building on momentum from COP30 and preparing for Earth Day 2026. Priority efforts focused on expanding the climate-education funding landscape, consolidating NDC-related regional data, strengthening partnerships with governments and institutional actors, and advancing national MOUs. A key milestone is that 29 of 33 LAC countries now include climate and environmental education in their NDCs, positioning the region among global leaders. These gains mark the start of an action phase centered on financing, alliances, and civic engagement to deliver measurable impact.

La Semana de la Tierra será pionera en los esfuerzos de mayor alcance de EARTHDAY.ORG hasta la fecha al amplificar la inspiración y la acción en todo el mundo del 14 al 22 de abril en todo el mundo. Únase a nosotros virtualmente para una serie de Earth Day Lives o en persona en uno de nuestros principales eventos que ocurren en cada zona horaria.

El tema del Día de la Tierra 2023 se centra en involucrar a más de mil millones de personas, gobiernos, instituciones y empresas que participan en el Día de la Tierra para reconocer nuestra responsabilidad colectiva y ayudar a acelerar la transición hacia una economía verde equitativa y próspera para todos. Nos enfocamos en reformular la conversación, acelerar la acción y unir a todos para que entiendan que esto está a nuestro alcance si trabajamos juntos.
Ya sea que esté tomando medidas virtualmente o en persona, ¡puede unirse al movimiento ambiental más grande de la Tierra!
